entries.clue: Ear-flapping, snozzcumber-munching giant who trumpets visions into bedrooms
Roasted and ground, the dark cup that jolts a household awake
Cocoa sweet, churned by waterfall, that runs as a river through the factory
Poor lad who finds the final ticket and ends up owning the sweet works
Purple aromatic spikes that draw bees all through summer
Cured pork strips, smoked or unsmoked, spitting as they crisp
Whole patch of eggs and young that the nurses tend together
Sterile female bee taking on every job in the nest by turn
Top-hatted confectioner who hid five golden tickets inside his bars
Halved, grilled and slid onto the fried plate; a fruit, botanists insist
White-suited craftsperson who tends colonies and lifts out the frames
